decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is far from the core business and riskier, but naval programmes run for many years and an expanding firm with slack can carry a specialised line that wins defence contracts.
The explosion-proof line builds on core industrial competence and was being extended with an LED retrofit kit in 2019, which signals results that meet the aspiration.
The relaunched designer task light is close to the established offer and was still featured, so there is no clear shortfall to trigger search, although design products age quickly.
The pendant office luminaire fits the core office lighting business and costs little to keep while the firm is growing.
The premium pendant line with several models matches the firm's established offer and its premium positioning, so it is likely to stay in the portfolio.
